description: Accepted vulnerability exceptions for the CRAFT monorepo. Each entry documents a known CVE that has been reviewed and accepted, with a justification and expiry date. High-severity (CVSS >= 7.0) entries require explicit sign-off.

acceptedVulnerabilities.justification: next@14.0.4 is pinned at this version to maintain stability across all CRAFT apps. CVE-2024-34351 (SSRF via Host header) requires a crafted Host header from a reverse proxy misconfiguration. CRAFT does not use the affected redirect handler in server actions. Tracked for upgrade to >=14.1.1.
nanoid is a transitive dev dependency used only in test tooling (vitest). It is never executed in production. Low exploitability in this context.
postcss is used only at build time. Input is always from trusted internal source files, not user-supplied CSS. No production exposure.
follow-redirects is a transitive dependency of axios used only in server-side health-check calls to known internal endpoints. No user-controlled redirect targets.
